what_happened: Dispatch premise is stale: description cites gate20 failing at current_eager=67088 B vs baseline_bytes=66100 B, and test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh failing 2 of 13 cases. The overage was already closed by commit 9a43026d2 ('orchestrate conclusion: channel (a) direct fixes', 2026-10-16), which did a 381 B relocation trim plus a documented, dated baseline move 66100 -> 66800 with rationale inline. Plan therefore re-scoped from 'close the overage' to 'verify the closure and recover durable headroom via route (a)', since the surviving defect is a 93 B margin that re-fires the gate on the next ordinary eager edit.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/rules/artifact-formats.md' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.

Plan-declared file_scope at task creation time (5 entries) was narrower than the plan's own Phase 2 'Files to modify' list (8 rule files plus their non-eager destinations). git-commit-phase.sh's Containment Self-Check correctly dropped rules/artifact-formats.md from the first phase-2.1 commit as out-of-scope. Resolved by amending specs/state.json's file_scope for task 417 to the plan's authoritative Phase 2 file list (adding artifact-formats.md, state-management.md, pr-prohibition.md, email/EXTENSION.md, and the status-markers.md/lit-stage4a-flow.md/literature-organization.md/distill-usage.md destinations), then re-running the commit.

Phase 4 was run against the complete verify-deploy.sh aggregator rather than the dispatch file's Batch Gate Deferral scoped narrowing (--only-gate N or run-all.sh --only SUITE), which this dispatch's own dispatch file (.dispatch/5.md) directed for this exact phase since it is part of a multi-task /orchestrate batch. The full run completed: gate20 (this task's own target) is 4/4 PASS with 1488 B headroom; 9 of 38 other checks failed, all confirmed (per the orchestrator's own measured load figures, 1-min load avg 52.70 on a 24-core host with 21 concurrent verify-deploy/run-all processes from a concurrently-running peer session) as timeout kills under batch contention, not content regressions -- none of the 9 failing gates (4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 17, 21, 23, 24) touch eager-context budgets or this task's three edited files; gate4 (task-reference lint) and gate3 (doc-lint) were independently re-confirmed clean in an earlier --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 run, and specs/state.json schema validation was independently re-confirmed clean (0 failed) via validate-state.sh --deep outside the contended full run.
